reviewItem.question: For "Cilium now respects the port specified as part of the etcd configuration, rather than defaulting it to that of the service when the address matches a…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: The etcd.operator kvstore-opt Helm value option is now a no-op and has been removed; Cilium now respects the port in the etcd configuration and automatically enables Kubernetes service DNS name to ClusterIP translation for etcd.
